papers.title: Design-logic alignment in digital transformation: A qualitative meta-analysis of Kodak
papers.journal: The Journal of Strategic Information Systems
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Why does an incumbent like Kodak, despite investing early in digital technology, still fail to create and capture value? We argue that Kodak's fate exemplifies a canonical paradox of digital transformation (DT) because its organisational identity, strategy, and technology imperatives were not aligned. While research in information systems, strategy, and organisation theory has long emphasised these three imperatives independently, we lack a DT-specific synthesis that explains how they become aligned or drift into misalignment. To address this gap, we reframe DT as a Design-Logic Alignment process, synthesising insights from 30 years of research on Kodak to develop a framework that explains why incumbents with significant resources can still fail at DT.
papers.summary_ja: デジタルトランスフォーメーションに失敗した企業（コダック等）の根本原因を「デザインロジックの不整合」として定式化し、組織アイデンティティ・戦略・テクノロジーの三元的整合フレームワークを提示した理論的レビュー。

papers.title: Business Model Bundles: Implications for Innovation in the Circular Economy
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Business model (BM) innovation is essential to the transition towards a circular economy, yet customers often resist circular BMs. This study investigates how manufacturers can innovate BMs for circularity in ways that increase customer acceptance. Drawing on a multiple-case study of four manufacturers offering 21 product-service system BMs, we introduce a new concept, the business model bundle: a strategic offering that packages multiple BMs within one contract and gives customers flexibility to move between them over time. We identify three defining characteristics: the combination of BMs, customer flexibility to transition between BMs, and risk reallocation mechanisms.
papers.summary_ja: 循環経済への移行においてビジネスモデルを「バンドル」として組み合わせることで顧客の抵抗を克服できると示した実証研究で、製造業が複数のBMを同一契約内で提供する新概念「ビジネスモデルバンドル」を提示。

papers.title: How High‐Tech Firms Achieve Organizational Resilience Using Dynamic Capabilities and Different Types of Innovations in VUCA Environments
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT High-tech firms must achieve organizational resilience (OR) to remain viable in volatile, uncertain, complex, and ambiguous (VUCA) environments. Although specific dynamic capabilities (DCs), particularly integrative and reconfiguring capabilities, allow such firms to integrate and complement technologies across innovation types, their effects on OR remain underexplored. This study addresses this gap by examining how integrative and reconfiguring DCs interact with process and product innovation to influence OR in high-tech firms.
papers.summary_ja: VUCA環境においてハイテク企業が組織レジリエンスを達成するために「統合ケイパビリティ」と「再構成ケイパビリティ」の組み合わせが有効であることを実証し、イノベーションタイプ別の媒介メカニズムを解明した。

papers.title: A systematic review of foresight methods used in the formulation of futures scenarios: evidence from articles indexed in scopus and web of science (2014–2023)
papers.authors: Pedro León Cruz Aguilar et al.
papers.abstract: This study presents a systematic literature review of the foresight methods used in the formulation of futures scenarios, analyzing 115 articles indexed in Scopus and Web of Science between 2014 and 2023. Applying the PRISMA methodology, the review identifies a plural methodological ecosystem in which qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-method approaches coexist, with no single dominant framework.
papers.summary_ja: 2014〜2023年のScopus/WoS収録115論文を体系的にレビューし、フォーサイト手法の「方法論的多様性」を地図化した上で、シナリオ立案における手法選択の実践的指針を提供。

papers.title: Defining data-driven business models in the context of sustainability
papers.abstract: Purpose Data have been identified as a potential next source of value creation and competitive advantage for companies, giving rise to data-driven business models that rely on data as a key resource. Despite the central role of data in today's business, there is conceptual ambiguity regarding what constitutes a data-driven business model. This paper develops a systematic definitional framework for data-driven business models in the context of sustainability.
papers.summary_ja: サステナビリティ文脈における「データ駆動型ビジネスモデル」の概念的曖昧さを解消するため、システマティックな定義フレームワークを構築し、データが競争優位の次の源泉となる条件を整理した。

papers.title: AI capability and product innovation intensity: Driving B2B marketing innovation under varying levels of market turbulence
papers.abstract: In increasingly volatile markets, firms are turning to artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance innovation and maintain a competitive edge. However, many organizations continue to struggle to translate AI investments into meaningful innovation outcomes. This study develops and empirically tests a framework examining how AI capability is transformed into business-to-business (B2B) marketing innovation through organizational agility and product innovation intensity. Drawing on survey data from 239 Chinese firms, the findings reveal that AI capability drives B2B marketing innovation through a theorized mediation mechanism.
papers.summary_ja: AIケイパビリティが組織アジリティと製品イノベーション強度を媒介してB2Bマーケティングイノベーションに結びつくメカニズムを239社の中国企業サーベイで実証し、市場乱流度によるモデレーション効果を示した。

papers.title: More than regulation: How policy mixes shape innovation ecosystems in digital transformation
papers.abstract: The era of digital transformation drives the continuous restructuring of innovation ecosystems, challenging regulators to move beyond conventional regulations to address market and system failures. Although policy mixes are essential to address these challenges and promote innovation ecosystems, the efficacy of specific policy mix characteristics remains underexplored. This study develops a conceptual model to explore the mechanisms through which policy mix characteristics affect firm innovation in the digital transformation era.
papers.summary_ja: デジタルトランスフォーメーション時代に規制だけでなく政策ミックス（供給側・需要側・インフラ政策の組み合わせ）がイノベーションエコシステムの再構造化に与える影響メカニズムを概念モデルで示した。

papers.title: Toward an Audience‐Based View of Incumbent Adoption of Potentially Discontinuous Technologies: Evidence From Fintech
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT We advance an audience-based view of incumbent adoption of potentially discontinuous technologies. Drawing on theories of discursive institutional processes and categorical legitimacy, we model how incumbents navigate mixed judgments from external groupings in their environment, that is, audiences, when adopting prospective discontinuous technologies. We argue that incumbents filter this noisy discursive environment by factoring in audiences' credibility and authority.
papers.summary_ja: フィンテック事例を用いた149社の縦断データで、既存企業が潜在的非連続技術を採用する際に外部ステークホルダー（オーディエンス）の判断を如何にフィルタリングするかを実証し、オーディエンスベース・ビューを新提示。

papers.title: Beyond Linear Paths: Configurations of Networks, Knowledge, and Dynamic Capabilities for Sustainable MSMEs
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Despite extensive research on entrepreneurial business networks (EBNs), knowledge management (KM), and dynamic capabilities (DC), three questions remain theoretically underdeveloped and empirically unexplored in resource-constrained MSMEs. These concern the integrative mechanisms through which EBN and KM jointly cultivate DC, the differential mediation logic of DC across sustainability outcome types, and the configurational pathways through which these constructs collectively produce sustainability outcomes. Using PLS-SEM and fsQCA on data from 316 manufacturing MSMEs in Uttar Pradesh.
papers.summary_ja: 316社の製造中小企業データをPLS-SEMとfsQCAで分析し、起業家的ネットワーク・知識管理・動的ケイパビリティの「構成的経路」によってサステナビリティ成果が多様に達成されることを示した。

papers.title: Towards mission theory: A systematic literature review of its critiques and avenues for progress (2010–2025)
papers.abstract: During the last 15 years, researchers and practitioners alike showed a newfound interest in the potential of 'mission-oriented' innovation policy to tackle current societal challenges. In this period, the approach prompted multiple reflections and critiques from orthodox and heterodox scholars alike. However, a structured appraisal of this debate has been missing. Untangling its analytical complexity, this paper presents a systematic literature review of 224 articles and book chapters published between 2010 and 2025 to appraise the state-of-the-art debate within 'mission theory'.
papers.summary_ja: 2010〜2025年の224論文を分析し「ミッション指向型イノベーション政策」をめぐる批判と展望を体系化、ミッション理論の現状と課題を包括的にマッピングした高品質レビュー。
